# Lucky Landscapes

> Full-service residential and commercial landscaping, hardscaping, and lawn care company based in Lincoln, Nebraska. Locally owned and operated, free estimates, fast quotes.

Lucky Landscapes LLC serves Lincoln, NE and the surrounding Lancaster County area (including Waverly and Emerald). We handle lawn care, garden beds, hardscaping (paver patios, retaining walls, fire pits, above-ground pool base prep), fencing, property cleanup, and landscape design. Pricing is custom per project — homeowners and businesses can request a free quote at https://luckylandscapes.com/quote.

## Services

- [Lawn Care](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/lawn-care): Mowing, edging, trimming, blowing, bagging, and leaf cleanup — weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, one-time, or seasonal.
- [Garden Beds](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/garden-beds): New bed installation, mulch and rock refresh, edging, weed barrier, planting, transplanting, and weeding.
- [Hardscaping](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/hardscaping): Paver patios, retaining walls, walkways, fire pits, bed edging, and above-ground pool base prep.
- [Drainage & Grading](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/drainage): Regrading, French drains, dry wells, catch basins, swales, and downspout drainage for wet yards and water against the foundation.
- [Fencing](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/fencing): Wood privacy, picket, chain link, prefab ornamental, and custom ornamental iron fencing — install, tear-out, and permits.
- [Property Cleanup](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/property-cleanup): Spring and fall cleanups, leaf and brush removal, storm debris, and haul-away.
- [Landscape Design](https://luckylandscapes.com/services/landscape-design): Custom landscape design and design-build for residential and commercial properties.
